about_the_game:
SURVIVE THE COLD AND FACE THE FINAL BOSS

Face relentless waves of intelligent enemies that grow stronger, arrive more frequently, and swarm you in increasing numbers. Power yourself up and challenge the final boss when you feel ready — but don’t waste time, or the cold will kill you first.

Each run is a fresh challenge with new skills, new traits, and new zones to explore.

A HANDCRAFTED, FROZEN WORLD

  • 3 main zones, each with its own final boss and unique mechanics.

  • Handcrafted environments enhanced with random systems to ensure constant variety.

  • Every run is unique: skills, upgrades, enemies, and events on the map all change each attempt.

FAST-PACED, STRATEGIC GAMEPLAY

Skills trigger automatically based on precise rules, but your movement and aim still matter.
Explore the zones, collect powerful upgrades, and plan your routes to maximize your survival and loot.
The longer you hold out, the more enemies strengthen — and the harsher the cold becomes.

In the beginning, surviving more than 5 minutes per zone is already an achievement. A full run averages around 15 minutes if you defeat the zone boss.

CHARACTER BUILDING AND PROGRESSION

Kill enemies to gain levels and earn traits with upgrades to your stats or skills.
Take part in dynamic events for additional rewards:

  • Towers to destroy

  • Mini-bosses to defeat

  • Chests to open

  • Areas to capture

  • Extraction pillars to destroy for rewards — or to use as a gateway to the final boss

Every choice affects your survival and your rewards.

GAMEPLAY-CHANGING UPGRADES

These upgrades go far beyond simple bonuses:

  • Rare traits that fundamentally change your playstyle, altering specific skills or entire skill categories

  • Transformations, spirit summons, multi-casting, living blades, elemental storms...

Possibilities are nearly endless, and each run can turn into a full display of escalating power.

UNLOCK NEW CONTENT AS YOU PLAY

Each run unlocks new content:

  • 3 playable classes (for now)

  • 55 skills to experiment with: 20 global, 12 per class

  • 250+ traits: skill modifiers, category modifiers, rule-changing effects, and sometimes simple stat boosts

  • Every run grants gold you can spend in the meta-progression interface to improve your stats or unlock starting traits for future runs.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: 64-bit Windows Vista, Windows 8, Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: 2.3GHz or faster processor (Intel 2nd generation core i-series or equivalent)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: A race against the cold. Face overwhelming enemy waves in an action roguelite where every run is a fight for power and survival. Grow stronger, master your abilities, and kill the final boss before the frozen world consumes you.
supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian
*languages with full audio support
